ticks — ANNOTATE plot op

• Data kinds: image2d × axes → image2d

• Call: import annotate; annotate.ticks(img, axes, xticks=None, yticks=None, color='neutral', width=1, tick_len=5, label=True, label_fmt='{:g}', font_size=11, font_path=None, scheme='okabe_ito', text_color=None, style=None) (or opsannotate.get("ticks"))
